channel.title: A question about Parawatch Wiki
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "A question about Parawatch Wiki" - Does the foundation ever use it for anomaly discovery?

item.title: Re: A question about Parawatch Wiki
item.content:encoded: If I remember correctly there are at least a few stories that end with someone coming into the discussion and shutting it down or posting that it was nothing, where it's at least implied that the Foundation had jumped in. I'm pretty sure they do use it for scouting, which is part of the reason they even let it stay up.

item.title: Re: A question about Parawatch Wiki
item.content:encoded: I'm pretty sure that the Foundation usually just does their best to keep Parawatch from learning of any active anomalies. But I could see some user discovering a new anomaly, and the Foundation using that information to find and contain it.

item.title: A question about Parawatch Wiki
item.content:encoded: Does the foundation use Parawatch Wiki for discovering more about anomalous items or places anomalies have been spotted?
